lines.text: A **Deck App** is a user-authored interactive experience that runs on [VitaDeck](https://github.com/matemolnar8/vitadeck) on PlayStation Vita (or the desktop host). You write it in **React** against the **VitaDeck Runtime API** (`@vitadeck/sdk` components like `Screen`, `Text`, `Button`).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Add deck-app-init skill and mark monorepo skills internal.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Add deck-app-init skill and mark monorepo skills internal.
lines.text: At build time, the SDK compiles your **Deck App Source Entry** (`src/App.tsx` by default) into a **Deck App Package** — a portable `.vdapp` folder (plus a `.vdapp.zip` archive for upload). The package contains your compiled app and metadata; VitaDeck supplies React and the runtime on device.

lines.text: Both add `host/plugin.ts` (the commands Deck Apps import), `host/companion.ts` (the implementation the computer runs), `host/tsconfig.json`, `"hostPlugin": { "entry": "./host/companion.ts" }` in `vitadeck.config.json`, and a `host` script. `build` then also writes `dist/<slug>.vdplugin/` and `dist/<slug>.vdplugin.zip`. Typecheck with `npm run tsc`, which covers `host/`. Running, linking and installing plugins: [vitadeck-host-control](../vitadeck-host-control/SKILL.md).
